findings.summary: Standardization is computed on the full dataframe before the train/test split, leaking test-set statistics into training and making test AUC optimistic.

judge.reason: Describes leakage of test statistics via scaling before split, same as b1.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Train/serve skew: scaling statistics are computed from the input batch and not persisted, so inference on a single row yields NaN (std is NaN) and on a batch uses different mean/std than training.

judge.reason: Describes the known train/serve skew from unsaved scaling stats (and single-row NaN), not the leakage bug.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: A constant column has std of 0, causing division by zero (NaN/inf) that breaks fit.

judge.reason: Zero-variance column producing NaN/inf is a known other problem.

findings.label: valid_other
